name: Oak Wood Split Wine Barrel Planter 26"W x 35"L x 13"H, Pots & Planters,oak wood wine barrels, by Master Garden Products
description: These unique split wine barrels are wonderful as indoor decoration stands and outdoor planters. It saves space when used in the corners of your home, yet provides a large planting area outdoors as a beautifully decorated planter as it's large enough to fit all your favorite plants. We use authentic oak wood wine barrels with good quality and value in mind. Unlike whisky barrels, classic wine barrels are better built, and wrapped with three galvanized steel bands to prevent rust which are frequently seen in whiskey barrels. We give you the option of drilled drainage holes on the bottoms of your barrel planters. If you plan to use the wine barrels for planting, then drainage holes are needed, so excess water may drain out of the containers without drowning and killing the plants. Of course you may also use these barrel planters for other purposes without the need of drain holes at the bottoms. Planter stand not included. Made of reclaimed oak staves from reclaimed wine barrels; color tone may vary from one product to another Size: W 26" / D 35" / H 13".
